How different are the pairs 

I have different files snp pangenome that sohini generated, I think it has the SNPs of the core genes 
I have the SNP reference that shows the genes that are mapped with a reference genome 
I can use both of these. 

```{r}

Codes <- read_excel("/Users/mariaalejandragilpolo/Downloads/Strain_codes_ForTree.xlsx") 
#View(Codes)


# Sample columns in your full_table_recoded (0/1/NA matrix)
sample_cols <- setdiff(colnames(full_table_recoded), c("CHROM", "POS", "REF", "ALT"))

# Function: count SNP differences between two isolates, ignoring NAs in either
snp_distance <- function(isolate1, isolate2, gt_matrix) {
  g1 <- gt_matrix[[isolate1]]
  g2 <- gt_matrix[[isolate2]]
  
  # Only compare positions where both have non-NA calls
  valid <- !is.na(g1) & !is.na(g2)
  n_compared <- sum(valid)
  n_diff <- sum(g1[valid] != g2[valid])
  
  return(list(
    n_diff      = n_diff,
    n_compared  = n_compared,
    pct_diff    = 100 * n_diff / n_compared
  ))
}

# Define your 19 pairs as a data frame
pairs <- data.frame(
  pair_id = 1:19,
  dry     = c("AVT98", "AVT99", "AVT100", "AVT101", "AVT102", "AVT103", "AVT104", "AVT105", "AVT106", "AVT107", "AVT108", "AVT111", "AVT112", "AVT115", "AVT116", "AVT117", "AVT118", "AVT119", "AVT120"),   # fill in your actual pair members
  mucoid  = c("AVT29", "AVT15", "AVT16", "AVT91", "AVT12", "AVT3", "AVT4", "AVT18", "AVT92", "AVT93", "AVT94", "AVT41", "AVT49", "AVT95", "AVT96", "AVT86", "AVT78", "AVT73", "AVT72")
)
View(pairs)

# Compute distance for each pair
pairs$snps_different <- NA_integer_
pairs$snps_compared  <- NA_integer_
pairs$pct_different  <- NA_real_

for (i in 1:nrow(pairs)) {
  result <- snp_distance(pairs$dry[i], pairs$mucoid[i], full_table_recoded)
  pairs$snps_different[i] <- result$n_diff
  pairs$snps_compared[i]  <- result$n_compared
  pairs$pct_different[i]  <- result$pct_diff
}
View(full_table_recoded)
# View the results
View(pairs[order(pairs$snps_different), ])
#View(pairs[order(pairs$snps_different), ]) I am getting two pairs that have less than 5 or 6 SNPs of difference.
```

```{r}
wilcox_results <- map_dfr(genes, function(g) {

  x <- PresenceAbsence[[g]]

  if (length(unique(x)) < 2) return(NULL)

  freq <- mean(x == 1, na.rm = TRUE)
  if (freq < 0.05 || freq > 0.95) return(NULL)

  res <- wilcox.test(
    PresenceAbsence$Glucose_OD600_ave ~ x,
    exact = FALSE
  )

  tibble(
    Gene = g,
    gene_freq = freq,
    n_present = sum(x == 1),
    n_absent  = sum(x == 0),
    p_value = res$p.value,
    median_present = median(PresenceAbsence$Glucose_OD600_ave[x == 1]),
    median_absent  = median(PresenceAbsence$Glucose_OD600_ave[x == 0]),
    delta_median   = median_present - median_absent
  )
}) %>%
  mutate(p_adj = p.adjust(p_value, method = "fdr")) %>%
  arrange(p_value)

View(wilcox_results)
```

### Assessing contamination 


```{r}

library(dplyr)

# --- Per-isolate breakdown of the original genotype calls ---
classify_call <- function(x) {
  if (is.na(x)) return("missing")
  parts <- strsplit(as.character(x), "[/|]")[[1]]
  if (length(unique(parts)) == 1) {
    if (parts[1] == "0") return("hom_ref") else return("hom_alt")
  }
  return("het")
}

per_isolate <- sapply(full_table[, sample_cols], function(col) {
  table(factor(vapply(col, classify_call, character(1)),
               levels = c("hom_ref", "hom_alt", "het", "missing")))
})
per_isolate <- as.data.frame(t(per_isolate))
per_isolate$total <- rowSums(per_isolate)
per_isolate$pct_het     <- 100 * per_isolate$het     / per_isolate$total
per_isolate$pct_missing <- 100 * per_isolate$missing / per_isolate$total

# Sort to find the worst offenders
per_isolate[order(-per_isolate$pct_het), ]      # likely contaminated isolates

View(per_isolate[order(-per_isolate$pct_het), ])

per_isolate[order(-per_isolate$pct_missing), ]  # low-coverage isolates





# Per-site het and missing counts
per_site_het <- apply(full_table[, sample_cols], 1, function(row) {
  sum(vapply(row, function(x) {
    if (is.na(x)) return(FALSE)
    parts <- strsplit(as.character(x), "[/|]")[[1]]
    length(unique(parts)) > 1
  }, logical(1)))
})

per_site_missing <- rowSums(is.na(full_table[, sample_cols]))

site_audit <- full_table[, c("CHROM", "POS", "REF", "ALT")]
site_audit$het_count     <- per_site_het
site_audit$missing_count <- per_site_missing
site_audit$pct_het_site     <- 100 * per_site_het     / length(sample_cols)
site_audit$pct_missing_site <- 100 * per_site_missing / length(sample_cols)

# Distribution of het counts per site — is it concentrated?
hist(site_audit$pct_het_site, breaks = 50,
     main = "Hets per site across 117 isolates",
     xlab = "% of isolates het at this site")

# How many sites are "noisy" by various thresholds?
sum(site_audit$pct_het_site > 10)   # >10% of isolates het here
sum(site_audit$pct_het_site > 20)
sum(site_audit$pct_het_site > 50)

# Where on the genome are the noisy sites?
table(site_audit$CHROM[site_audit$pct_het_site > 10])
```

```{r}
recode_gt <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  x[x == "0/0"] <- "0" #Has the Ref allele
  x[x == "1/1"] <- "1" #Has the alternate allele
  x[x == "0/1"] <- NA
  x[x == "1/0"] <- NA
  x[x == "./."] <- NA   # explicit missing calls
  as.numeric(x)
}
```

### Following claude's instructions 

```{r}

vcf <- read.vcfR("/Users/mariaalejandragilpolo/Downloads/pan_genome_variants.vcf")


library(vcfR)

gt_mat <- extract.gt(vcf, element = "GT", as.numeric = FALSE)

dosage <- apply(gt_mat, 2, function(x) {
  x[x == "0/0"] <- 0
  x[x == "0/1" | x == "1/0"] <- 1
  x[x == "1/1"] <- 2
  x[!(x %in% c("0","1","2"))] <- NA   # anything else (./., 1/2, 2/2) → NA
  as.numeric(x)
})
rownames(dosage) <- rownames(gt_mat)

# Filter by missingness and MAF
site_miss <- rowMeans(is.na(dosage))
dosage    <- dosage[site_miss < 0.1, , drop = FALSE]

af  <- rowMeans(dosage, na.rm = TRUE) / 2
maf <- pmin(af, 1 - af)
dosage <- dosage[!is.na(maf) & maf > 0.05, , drop = FALSE]

# (Optional) one SNP per gene group
chrom <- getFIX(vcf)[, "CHROM"]
chrom <- chrom[as.integer(rownames(dosage))]   # align to surviving rows
# simpler: just skip pruning for now

# Mean-impute
dosage <- t(apply(dosage, 1, function(x) {
  x[is.na(x)] <- mean(x, na.rm = TRUE); x
}))

# --- THE FIX: drop zero-variance SNPs before PCA ---
site_var <- apply(dosage, 1, var)
dosage   <- dosage[site_var > 1e-8, ]
cat("SNPs remaining for PCA:", nrow(dosage), "\n")

# PCA
X   <- t(dosage)                  # rows = strains, cols = SNPs # CHECK THE TRANSTHING
pca <- prcomp(X, scale. = TRUE)

var_exp <- pca$sdev^2 / sum(pca$sdev^2)
plot(pca$x[, 1], pca$x[, 2],
     xlab = sprintf("PC1 (%.1f%%)", 100 * var_exp[1]),
     ylab = sprintf("PC2 (%.1f%%)", 100 * var_exp[2]))

pcs <- data.frame(strain = rownames(pca$x), pca$x[, 1:5])
```

```{r}

### For basic tree

Strain_Code_Tree_meta <- meta_tree %>%
  select(Strain, Strain_Code) ## Strain_Code is for the label, Strain is to match Sohini's tree data
Strain_Code_Tree_meta

## The new operator I am learning about %<+% is an operator that attaches a metadata (in my case Strain_Code_Tree_meta) with a tree (in this case "tree") based on the "label" column (in my case "Strain"). Note, in my case instead of "label" I am using "Strain" but ggtree automatically looks at the first column that I on purpose assigned as "Strain" as you can see in the previous lines. Maybe I need to consider changing "Strain" for "label"? Not sure, the code seems to be working well. 

p <- ggtree(tree, branch.length = "none") %<+% Strain_Code_Tree_meta + ## I removed the branch length on purpose because I wanted to look homogeneous since Sohini's paper will have the original one. But Liana asked me to put back the branches. Since I remove the branch.length then this is called a cladogram, not a phylogram. 
  geom_tiplab(aes(label = Strain_Code), size = 2.8, offset = 0.02) + ## I want the name of the tips to be the 001, 002 format
  theme_tree2() +
  xlim_tree(4)


p

## Add the morphology
p <- p +
  geom_fruit(
    data = meta_tree %>% select(Strain, Morphology),
    geom = geom_tile,
    mapping = aes(y = Strain, x = "Morphology", fill = Morphology),
    width = 1,
    offset = 0.04,
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    color = "white",
    linewidth = 0.2
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = morph_cols,
    name = "Morphology"
  )

p

## Add glucose

p <- p +
  ggnewscale::new_scale_fill() +
  geom_fruit(
  data = meta_tree %>% select(Strain, Glucose_OD600_ave),
  geom = geom_tile,
  mapping = aes(y = Strain, x = "Glucose", fill = Glucose_OD600_ave),
  width = 1,
  offset = 0.03,
  inherit.aes = FALSE,
  color = "white",
  linewidth = 0.2
  ) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(
#    colours = diverge_hcl(117,h= c(246, 40), c = 96), ## I really like diverge_hcl for this trait
   colours = colorRamps::magenta2green(117), ## Liana suggested colorRamps, thsi was my favorite out of th eoptions but I am not convinced. Link: chrome-extension://efaidnbmnnnibpcajpcglclefindmkaj/https://www.nceas.ucsb.edu/sites/default/files/2020-04/colorPaletteCheatsheet.pdf
    na.value = "white",
    name = "Glucose"
  )


p


## Add the pair
p <- p +
  ggnewscale::new_scale_fill() +
  geom_fruit(
    data = meta_tree %>% select(Strain, Pairs),
    geom = geom_tile,
    mapping = aes(y = Strain, x = "Pair", fill = Pairs),
    width = 1,
    offset = 0.03,
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    color = "white",
    linewidth = 0.25
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = pair_cols, na.value = "white", name = "Pair") +
  geom_fruit(
    data = meta_tree %>% select(Strain, Pairs),
    geom = geom_text,
    mapping = aes(y = Strain, x = "Pair", label = Pairs),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    size = 2.2,
    color = "black"
  )

p

ggsave(
  "AVT_tree_all.pdf_withlegends.pdf",
  plot = p,
  width = 8,
  height = 15,
  units = "in"
)

#no legends
p <- p + theme(legend.position = "none")
p
ggsave(
  "AVT_tree_all.pdf",
  plot = p,
  width = 10,
  height = 20,
  units = "in"
)
```

```{r}
library(ggtree)
library(ggtreeExtra)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

p <- ggtree(tree) %<+% meta_tree + ## This meta_tree_plot has all the values I need.
  geom_tiplab(
    aes(label = Strain_Code),
    align     = TRUE,          # <- aligns all labels to the same x
    linetype  = "dashed",      # <- dashed guide lines
    linesize  = 0.3,
    size      = 2.5,
    offset    = 0.0001         # small nudge from the tip
  ) +
  # Morphology column
  geom_fruit(
    geom     = geom_tile,
    mapping  = aes(y = label, fill = Morphology),
    width    = 0.0005,         # tile width in tree units — tune to your scale bar
    offset   = 0.15,           # distance from the tip labels (as fraction of tree width)
    pwidth   = 0.05
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    name   = "Morphology",
    values = morph_cols,
    guide  = guide_legend(order = 1)
  ) +
  # Start a new fill scale for the next column
  ggnewscale::new_scale_fill() +
  # Glucose gradient column
  geom_fruit(
    geom    = geom_tile,
    mapping = aes(y = label, fill = Glucose_OD600_ave),
    width   = 0.0005,
    offset  = 0.05,
    pwidth  = 0.05
  ) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(
    name     = "Glucose OD600",
    option   = "C",
    na.value = "white",
    guide    = guide_colorbar(order = 2)
  ) +
  ggnewscale::new_scale_fill() +
  # Pairs column
  geom_fruit(
    geom    = geom_tile,
    mapping = aes(y = label, fill = Pairs),
    width   = 0.0005,
    offset  = 0.05,
    pwidth  = 0.05
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    name     = "Pair",
    values   = pair_cols,
    na.value = "white",
    guide    = guide_legend(order = 3, ncol = 2)
  ) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.key.size = unit(0.4, "cm")
  )



p
```

Where are the strains that Liz chose?


Liz used strain 001, 012, 044, 059, 070, 077, 112, 117


```{r}

Codes <- read_excel("/Users/mariaalejandragilpolo/Downloads/Strain_codes_ForTree.xlsx") #Has all the 117 strains
#View(Codes)
Codes_Liz <- Codes %>%
  mutate(
    Liz = ifelse(Strain_Code %in% c("001", "012", "044", "059", "070", "077", "112", "117"), "Chosen", NA)
  )
#View(Codes_Liz)



#View(Codes_glucose)
meta_tree <- meta_raw %>%
  select(-any_of("label")) %>%
  left_join(
    Codes_Liz %>%
      select(-any_of("label")) %>%
      select(Strain, Strain_Code, Pairs, Liz),
    by = "Strain"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    label = Strain,
    Morphology = recode(Morphology,
                        "R" = "Mucoid",
                        "P" = "Dry"),
    Morphology = factor(Morphology, levels = c("Mucoid", "Dry")),
    pair_status = ifelse(is.na(Pairs), "No pair", "Paired")
  ) #%>%
#View(meta_tree)
#  filter(!label %in% tips_to_remove) ### Remove these from the metadata


meta_tree_plot <- meta_tree %>%
  select(label, Strain_Code, Morphology, Pairs, Liz) %>%
  mutate(
    Morphology = factor(Morphology, levels = c("Mucoid", "Dry")),
    Pairs = ifelse(is.na(Pairs), "No pair", as.character(Pairs)),
    Pairs = factor(Pairs),
    Pair_label = ifelse(Pairs == "No pair", "", as.character(Pairs))
  )
meta_tree_plot
# Morphology
morph_cols <- c(
  "Mucoid" = "#4eadb9",
  "Dry" = "#e0ba3e"
)
```
